snippet.title: R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Outsmart and outgun your opponent in R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos, the ultimate turn-based sci-fi strategy collection! This two-game combination of the classic R-Type Tactics titles arrives on modern consoles for the first time, equipped with an armada of unique units to deploy across dozens of levels. Multiple campaigns allow you to take on the Bydo Empire or even play as them yourself. Their fates are up to you!

This is the first time R-Type Tactics II has released in the west, and the first time anybody will get to try the additional Cosmos content!

Take on the challenge when R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos comes out for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, XBOX X|S, and PC on June 18, 2026!

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://www.nisamerica.com/r-type-tactics/
